title: Wing and Water ABC
hook: Feet and wings tell different travel stories.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: 3D preschool water-and-land bird storybook, blue-green wetland palette, calm friendly birds, clean foreground spacing

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing locomotion across bird habitats
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: movement cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe abstract gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a marimba twig-tap plus brushed-percussion nest answer after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a marimba twig-tap plus brushed-percussion nest answer after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Wing and Water ABC a locomotion-and-habitat comparison: wading legs, webbed feet, diving, soaring, hovering, climbing, ground running and flightlessness replace the false nest-building premise.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child tracks how feet, wings, bills and habitat fit movement on water, land, trunk or air.
